changes: Fresh soundtrack-library v3 catalogues select 90s Synth by default while migrated libraries retain their saved mode.
The player presents Now Playing, Shuffle all music, style selection and playlist selection before advanced tools.
Sound, custom filters, offline albums, MP3 editing, playlist authoring, assignments, backups and community downloads start collapsed and remain keyboard/controller reachable.
The Field Kit audio recipe now fingerprints soundtrack-panel.css as well as soundtrack-panel.mjs so future player presentation changes reopen review.
Hosts without a published catalogue keep the built-in and imported playlist selector in the visible Now Playing card, with automatic map/campaign/theme fallback wording.

completeSparseRun.explanation: Failures require intentionally absent large optional authoring, picture, video and chapter fixtures in the low-storage checkout. Changed soundtrack and navigation cohorts pass separately. Hosted qualification must use a complete checkout.

desktop: The music player showed the current track title, artist, playback time, filename, creator source and license.
Play this style streamed Super Scary Cave Dragon (Sega-style FM synth mix) by Ragnar Random.
Shuffle all music changed the status to All styles, selected My Mix and streamed Silver Bullet by Vitalezzz.
All seven advanced sections remained collapsed until explicitly opened.
responsive390x844: Quick choices form one readable column without horizontal overflow.
The selected-style status and primary Shuffle all music action remain visible before advanced controls.

limits: This approves the scoped player behavior and source recipe only; it does not approve musical suitability of the hosted creator recordings.
UA-FPV recordings remain excluded from public playback because a YouTube playlist does not establish public MP3 redistribution permission.
Physical-device, frozen-build, offline and public-release qualification remain required.
